name: io.github.duranivrobert-glitch/riv
title: R/IV — Verify Claims, Citations & Agent Actions
description: Verify claims, citations & agent actions. Free receipt trial; paid prices via live R/IV quotes.

tools.name: capabilities.list
tools.description: List R/IV capabilities, contracts, availability and purchasability.

tools.name: service.match
tools.description: Match a bounded goal to the smallest sufficient R/IV capability.

goal.description: The goal or outcome the caller wants verified, in plain language. R/IV matches it to the smallest capability that can verify it.

preferredCapability.description: Optional capability ID to prefer when several capabilities could satisfy the goal. R/IV still returns the smallest sufficient match.

tools.name: pricing.quote
tools.description: Return current pricing state or a non-charging quote. Never executes or charges.

capabilityId.description: The R/IV capability ID this call is about, for example claim.check.

capability_id.description: Optional alias for capabilityId; identifies the R/IV operation to quote without charging or executing it.

maximumAuthorizedCost.description: Optional maximum cost in USD the caller authorizes for this capability. The quote only reports whether the capability fits within this bound; a pricing quote never charges.

tools.name: provenance.receipt.trial
tools.description: Run one free signed R/IV provenance receipt trial. No payment or account required.

trial_id.description: Caller-chosen unique trial ID, 12 to 200 characters, used to identify an idempotent free provenance-receipt trial; it is not a payment credential.

input.description: Evidence or artifact metadata for the free provenance-receipt trial, such as source_records and job_or_artifact. Use only synthetic or public information; never include secrets.

tools.name: example.get
tools.description: Return a synthetic/public example for a capability.

capabilityId.description: The R/IV capability ID this call is about, for example claim.check.

tools.name: system.status
tools.description: Return public-safe R/IV machine availability and trust state.

tools.name: citation.verify
tools.description: R/IV citation.verify — independent evidence-verification primitive for verification. Completed paid execution returns an RVO plus signed R/IV Verification Receipt.

claim.description: The factual claim to verify, stated as one checkable assertion. R/IV tests this claim against the admitted evidence.

citation_url.description: The URL of the cited source to verify. R/IV fetches this page and checks whether it actually supports the claim.

quoted_or_cited_text.description: The exact text quoted or cited from the source. R/IV compares this wording against the source at citation_url to catch altered or invented quotes.

request_id.description: Caller-generated idempotency key for this paid execution attempt.

tools.name: claim.check
tools.description: R/IV claim.check — independent evidence-verification primitive for claims. Completed paid execution returns an RVO plus signed R/IV Verification Receipt.

claim.description: The factual claim to verify, stated as one checkable assertion. R/IV tests this claim against the admitted evidence.

context.description: Extra context that narrows how the claim should be read, such as the document, conversation, or situation it came from. Optional background for the verifier; it is not itself verified.

public_urls.description: Public URLs admitted as evidence for this execution. Only publicly reachable pages are used; private or authenticated URLs are not fetched.

request_id.description: Caller-generated idempotency key for this paid execution attempt.

tools.name: answer.audit
tools.description: R/IV answer.audit — independent evidence-verification primitive for verification. Completed paid execution returns an RVO plus signed R/IV Verification Receipt.

answer.description: The answer to audit. R/IV checks each factual assertion in this answer against the admitted evidence and reports what is supported, contradicted, or unverifiable.

public_urls.description: Public URLs admitted as evidence for this execution. Only publicly reachable pages are used; private or authenticated URLs are not fetched.

strictness.description: How strict the audit should be: standard checks the answer against the admitted evidence, while high additionally requires every load-bearing assertion to be directly supported.

target.description: The claim, source, entity, or dependency to watch. R/IV monitors this target and reports material changes.

monitor_type.description: What kind of thing is being monitored: a claim, a source, an entity, or a dependency. This sets what counts as a material change.

url.description: The URL to verify or snapshot. It must be publicly reachable; R/IV fetches it directly to check identity, content, or availability.

expected_identity.description: The identity the source is expected to have, such as the publisher, organization, or domain owner. R/IV checks the fetched source against this identity.

context.description: Extra context that narrows how the claim should be read, such as the document, conversation, or situation it came from. Optional background for the verifier; it is not itself verified.

quote.description: The quotation to verify, as exact text. R/IV checks that this wording appears in the cited source and is attributed correctly.

source_url.description: The URL of the source the quote or facts come from. R/IV fetches this page to verify the material against it.

attribution.description: The attribution claimed for the quote, such as the author or publication. R/IV checks that the source actually attributes the quote this way.

context.description: Extra context that narrows how the claim should be read, such as the document, conversation, or situation it came from. Optional background for the verifier; it is not itself verified.

claim.description: The factual claim to verify, stated as one checkable assertion. R/IV tests this claim against the admitted evidence.

value.description: The numeric value claimed, as a number. R/IV checks this value against the cited source and the stated unit.

unit.description: The unit of the claimed value, such as USD, percent, or kilograms. The value is only meaningful with its unit.

as_of.description: The date the claimed value applies to, in ISO 8601 format. Values are verified as of this date, not as of today.

public_urls.description: Public URLs admitted as evidence for this execution. Only publicly reachable pages are used; private or authenticated URLs are not fetched.

purpose.description: Why this snapshot is being taken, such as evidence preservation or audit. The purpose is recorded with the snapshot.

default_timezone.description: The IANA timezone to assume for events that carry no timezone, such as America/Denver. Required so ambiguous times are interpreted consistently.
